content.value: A UNS G10350 steel shaft, heat-treated to a minimum yield strength of 100 kpsi, has a diameter of 1 $\frac { 7 } { 1 6 }$ in. The shaft rotates at 1000 rev/min and transmits 50 hp through a gear. Select an appropriate key for the gear, with a design factor of 2.0.
